description: Get the full neutral writeup of one news event by slug: 'story', Pure Report's own neutral news story (headline + paragraphs, written from the outlets' reports and checked before publishing); 'account', a sentence-cited breakdown (lede, what-we-know bullets with verbatim source receipts, single-source attributed items) when one passed its gates; and a coverage census (how many outlets by political lean, earliest report). Either writeup may be null; the census is always returned.

slug.description: Event slug from trending_events or a search_news result, e.g. "tyler-robinson-trial-for-charlie-kirk-murder".

name: get_event
title: Neutral event writeup
